title: Remediate private Vault delivery design blockers
classification_reason: multiple validation layers and independent review
expected_outcome: Vault chart, runtime images, and bootstrap toolchain have deterministic private-delivery contracts; toolchain inputs are pinned; and a tested revoke-stage plan proves temporary EKS cluster-admin removal.
constraints: Do not mirror artifacts or publish images.
Do not apply Terraform or invoke AWS, EKS, Vault, or Kubernetes.
Do not initialize or unseal Vault, read or write secrets, enable public access, deploy workloads, merge, or alter workflow permissions.
Keep all validation offline and non-sensitive.

external_actions: publish the reviewed vault-bootstrap toolchain image to GHCR and record its immutable digest

delegations.escalation_trigger: a remedy requires unpinned or public artifact access, weakens revocation, or changes runtime secret boundaries

validation: harness structural and applicable policy checks
